text: Adsit vobis gratia, misericordia, pax a Deo Patre, et a Domino Jesu Christo, Patris Filio, cum veritate ac caritate.
note: *Patrem/Patre/Pater/Patris* capital, God the Father (decision 20), as Jas 1:17, 1:27 and your *Deus et Pater*; 1573 lowers *pater* everywhere; *Fīlius* capital, the Son of God (decision 20), as Heb 1:2, 1:5 and your Gal 2:20 *Fīliī Deī*; 1573 lower (παρὰ θεοῦ πατρός … τοῦ υἱοῦ τοῦ πατρός) (Claude, 2026-11-12)
